proposed_capability: P95 design/prototype and P124 cohesive extension of existing ui_chrome, camera_traverse and cooperative Playwright host adapter. Produce an inspectable dynamic per-mode target/hotkey/console atlas, enforce explicit calibrated target/scene version and freshness for Playwright-hosted game input, and park the mouse in the interior after each action. Respect 15s human-inactivity queue and one desktop owner; no native game proof or uncontrolled automation.
player_save_control_impact: Opt-in injected existing Playwright page, no launcher, no screen daemon, no save operations. Calibrations are offline or operator-attested and checked against live probes; unknown scenes/profile/geometry, active player, missing proof or uncalibrated target fail closed. Effect occurs only through cooperative queue checkpoints; parking also checks presence before moving.
expected_outcome: Machine-readable target/hotkey/console inventory sourced from existing authoritative contracts; strict target calibration gate, version/profile/geometry and fresh game-state checks, bounded click, safe interior rest after click. Tests exercise missing calibration, wrong mode/patch/geometry, human interruption, stale target, cursor reset, and current browser adapter regression.
negative_tests: Missing independent scene cue or stale target blocks input
Mouse parks interior after admitted click
Human interrupts before rest: no cursor fight, effect quarantined
Unknown/unsafe console command cannot be automatically executed
Browser adapter existing click/fill behavior unchanged
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; no game install, no saved-file mutation, no live account setting mutation.
unresolved_unknowns: P08 local exact-patch calibration, native-game host integration, and game camera/no-drift certification remain required
